threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 1,082 -> 1,418 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 625 Cr (Mar 2025) -> 200 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: Institutional holding keeps falling - the selling has not stopped.
threats.evidence: Institutional Holding trend (quarterly): Decreasing for 4 quarters

threats.point: Receivables are stretching year on year.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -1.78 pp, DII -2.68 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The company strategically kept more raw material inventory due to ongoing geopolitical issues.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "And added to that, this quarter we have strategically kept little more raw material inventory. Reason being the geopolitical issues what is taking place." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: The timing of the backward integration investment is subject to final clarity on ALMM List 3 and market conditions.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The timings of this investment will remain subject to the final clarity on ALMM List 3 and prevailing market conditions." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Rains in certain areas prevented customers from picking up materials.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Because of some rains in those areas, they are not able to pick up the materials." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Jun) are still in the cycle.
